entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one canonical UE football portrait Master, exact 1024 x 1536 pixels, vertical 2:3, opaque RGB PNG. Create ONE original fictional adult male professional football defender for canonical PlayerKey Prototype.ManchesterCity.NathanAke. This is a roster character, not a celebrity poster or a likeness reconstruction. Subject: medium-brown skin, athletic lean strong build, shoulder-length dark loose textured twists swept back from the face, no blond braids, light neat facial stubble, calm focused eyes, mature composed expression. Distinct original face. Front-facing chest-up to lower torso, eye-level camera, head centered at x=48%, full hair top at about 8% image height, eyes at 24%, chin at 39%, neck and both shoulders entirely readable, wide visible upper chest and jersey extending to bottom. Hair silhouette stays within x=27%..69%; reserve quiet background at upper right x=73%..96%, y=5%..38% for downstream UI. Match a restrained art-directed editorial football card family: realistic anatomy and readable natural skin, gently simplified and polished surfaces, subtle illustration finish, premium modern sports portrait, neither cartoon nor extreme pore-detail photorealism. Sky-blue short-sleeved football jersey, fine tonal knit, narrow navy-and-white round collar and cuff trim, simple white side insert, NO official crest, NO logos, sponsors, brand marks, lettering or numbers. Dark midnight-navy / deep-teal blurred night stadium background, subtle cool soft key and soft fill, very restrained teal edge light, a few small dim distant warm lights off to the sides, no bright lamp band crossing the head, no halo, no tactical diagram or geometric decoration. Enough crop-safe head, neck, shoulders and chest for horizontal 192x128 and near-square Pitch derivatives from this same source. No ball, hands, other people, framing, UI, text, watermark, fake transparency or panels. Output only the single finished portrait.
